newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-ROMANIA'S DRAGOMIR WINS FOURTH TITLE IN ROSMALEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ROMANIA'S DRAGOMIR WINS FOURTH TITLE IN ROSMALEN.

text.p: Third seeded Roxandra Dragomir of Romania won her fourth career title on Sunday when she beat unseeded Dutchwoman Miriam Oremans 5-7 6-3 6-4 in the final of the Heineken Trophy grasscourt tournament.
The final was completed on Sunday after the match was stopped at 5-7 6-3 3-1 on Saturday when organisers decided rain had made the court too slippery.
Dragomir is seeded 15th at Wimbledon. REUTER
